create_mm_receiver: create an MMReceiver instance (HTTP or gRPC) for disaggregated prefill multimodal embedding transfer
build_mm_receiver_http_encode: build an HTTP-based multimodal encoder receiver that distributes image/video/audio items across encoder nodes and receives embeddings via ZMQ
build_mm_receiver_grpc_encode: build a gRPC-based multimodal encoder receiver that distributes image items across encoder nodes and receives embeddings via mooncake or ZMQ
run_assign_items_by_modality: run modality-aware load balancing to distribute multimodal items across encoder nodes with cross-modality rotation
test_try_recv_mm_data: test receiving and aggregating multimodal embedding data from encoder nodes with timeout and error handling
